$comment: Config for the codex-delegation skill. Kill switch: set enabled=false. Env override for one session: CODEX_DELEGATION=0 (force off) or 1 (force on). artifact_dir is relative to the profile's scratch directory ($YBASE_SCRATCH).

thresholds.$comment: Auto-delegation fires when the measured size meets or exceeds the profile's threshold. Below it, Claude does the work locally. Raise to delegate less; set a profile's auto=false to require explicit invocation.
